module.name: Social Post
module.notes: Social Post header phase with two symmetric five-slot rows.

intent.responsibility: Own the Social Post header, Media and fixed Message composition.
intent.visualBoundary: Render a Surface-backed header, padded Media boundary and a flexible Message zone composed from Bubble, Text Input Bar and Keyboard.
intent.runtimeBehavior: The Variant owns structure, Component Variants, padding and separators; Runtime owns row content, the Gallery directory and selected index, Media framing and height, message text, write-on and composer visibility.
intent.forwarding: The selected Gallery index explicitly drives both the Gallery position and the paged Media source; message text is explicitly supplied to the selected Bubble, Text Input Bar and Keyboard boundaries.
intent.temporalOwnership: The Screen owns message write-on while child Components retain their local rendering behavior.
intent.productionContext: Resolve only through the exact Production Screen to Shot owner Actor to Theme and Device context.
